findings.failure_path: the --wording-only-proof-file refusal is gated on args.base, so --diff-file with --wording-only-proof-file and no --base passes freeze_packet even though staged-review-contract.md and acceptance A9 state the combination is refused outright, and the A9 probe only exercises the with-base shape, so whether the proof machine check (built for full-context base-derived diffs) then evaluates author-assembled bytes is unverifiable from the packet
findings.smallest_fix: drop the args.base conjunct so any --diff-file plus --wording-only-proof-file is refused, and extend the A9 probe with base_ref=None

concern_results.conclusion: The prefix anchor is enforced as packet.startswith(candidate) with prepended-decoy, interleaved, truncated, and unrelated packets all refused and covered by the new probe; chain succession and the in-chain prior-receipt checks now compare candidate to candidate while each receipt records the packet it actually read, and the merge-side binder still recomputes the candidate from the repository, so no sequence of widened rounds can bind landing bytes a reviewer did not read; candidate_paths derive from the candidate so appended context cannot add or drop owners; the empty-candidate and --paths-without---base guards are present; the one bypass found is that the wording-only refusal is conditional on --base, contradicting the categorical refusal the contract documents (finding below)

The containment evidence discriminates: collapsing the candidate identity into the packet hash and deleting the anchor check each red only their owning cases with green controls, the non-discriminating binder mutation is honestly recorded, and the cross-side case asserts a widened round's recorded candidate equals the gate-recomputed identity with base and paths taken from candidate_scope rather than hand-built; the landing boundary itself holds, leaving the untested no-base wording-only refusal as the single unverified boundary claim

challenge_focus: Attack the prefix anchor and the two-object split. The packet must now BEGIN with the base-derived candidate. Find a packet that satisfies startswith yet still misleads the reviewer about what lands -- trailing content that reads as the real change, a second candidate copy, or context that resupplies a dropped hunk. The chain compares candidate to candidate, not packet to packet: construct a round sequence this permits whose combined evidence misrepresents what any single reviewer saw. Inspect the relaxations in _validate_chain_succession and the in-chain prior-receipt checks for a receipt shape now wrongly accepted. Can candidate_paths taken from the candidate under-select an owner that should have reviewed the change? Probe the empty-candidate guard, --paths without --base, and the wording-only refusal for bypasses, and check the ordering claim that bound evidence lands before the rounds and receipts after.
